comparison_protocol: r3.2: initial conditions are part of the ledger-bound comparison identity; J5 cold_adoption/recurring_rollout/recovery never pool; shared/automatic stage coverage is independent of action counting; required human decisions remain measured
driver_export: async createDriver({jobId, runId, registration}) -> {mode, provenance, perform, observe, teardown}

driver_contract.perform: async perform(stage, {ledger, signal}); drive only frozen public UI/CLI interfaces; instrument every meaningful primitive plus S/H/R separately. Mechanical stages may share a completed same-phase action through ledger.stage or supply independent automatic evidence. Honor stage.human_actions and cancellation. Each human decision needs a new stage-local action plus an independent stage receipt binding identical decision packet_sha256/preconditions_sha256 hashes; earlier decisions never satisfy later stages.
driver_contract.observe: async observe(check, {signal}) -> {source, value, artifact_sha256}; read independent API/PG/filesystem/model-boundary/external evidence, never a product toast
driver_contract.teardown: async teardown() -> {qualified}; qualified only after owned resources are cancelled, settled or explicitly uncertain, terminated and destruction verified
driver_contract.raw_evidence: Raw customer evidence stays in separately authorized redacted artifacts; the ledger retains opaque IDs and hashes only
driver_contract.comparator: Use the strongest applicable customer-configured workflow; independent review receipt binds both ledger hashes. Documentation and synthetic runs cannot establish a ratio.

harness_interfaces: ActionLedger.stage({step,phase,source,artifactHash,actionSequences:[],decision?:{packet_sha256,preconditions_sha256}}) records independent completion without fabricating an operator action; the runner binds preregistration before any action
